title.value: Using Interactive Feedback to Improve the Accuracy and Explainability of Question Answering Systems Post-Deployment
title.justification: The title was extracted from the paper's front matter, providing a clear indication of the study's focus on improving QA systems with interactive feedback.
title.quote: Using Interactive Feedback to Improve the Accuracy and Explainability of Question Answering Systems Post-Deployment

extractions.description: This paper explores the post-deployment phase of Question Answering (QA) systems, utilizing interactive feedback from users to enhance both the accuracy and explainability of these systems. The study introduces a dataset named FEEDBACK QA, which includes structured ratings and unstructured natural language explanations provided by users. The feedback is then used to train models that can improve answer accuracy and provide explanations, helping users discern the correctness of answers. Evaluation shows enhancements in model performance, not only for the system initially deployed but also for other stronger, non-deployed models.

primary_category.justification: The main focus of the paper is on improving QA systems' post-deployment performance through user feedback, which does not align with any direct eco-responsible AI categories such as those concerned with climate change, sustainability, or environmental protection.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we ask the question: Can we improve QA systems further post-deployment based on user interactions?

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not fall into any of the predefined sub-categories focused on eco-responsibility, as it primarily addresses user interaction data to improve computational models for QA systems.
primary_sub_category.quote: We focus on two kinds of improvements: 1) improving the QA system’s performance itself, and 2) providing the model with the ability to explain the correctness or incorrectness of an answer.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on computational model improvement through feedback does not introduce a new eco-responsible category but rather elaborates on post-deployment learning in artificial intelligence.
new_primary_category.quote: In particular, an untapped resource is the large amounts of user interaction data produced after the initial deployment of the system.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The context and purpose of the paper are not related to eco-responsible AI applications; therefore, it does not introduce or necessitate a new sub-category in this context.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We collect a retrieval-based QA dataset, FEEDBACK QA, which contains interactive feedback from users.
